{{Cat main|Integer}}
{{Commons category}}

The '''[[integer]]s''' consist of 0, the [[natural number]]s (1, 2, 3,{{nbsp}}...), and their [[negative number|negatives]] (−1, −2, −3,{{nbsp}}...).  The [[Set (mathematics)|set]] of all integers is usually denoted by '''Z''' (or Z in [[blackboard bold]], <math>\mathbb{Z}</math>), which stands for ''Zahlen'' ([[German language|German]] for "numbers").

Articles about integers are automatically sorted in numerical order. Do not set a [[WP:SORTKEY|sort key]] in them, unless [[decimal mark#Digit grouping|thousands separators]] are used.
